parameters.content:
## Monthly Report Digest
Path A (day 5, 09:00 Africa/Cairo): reads Members + Monthly Submissions, builds a per-member table for the previous month, optional Gemini summary (names/counts/links only), emails the professor (Gmail HTML) and sends totals + missing list on Telegram. If nobody submitted, it still sends the report.
Path B (day 10, 09:00): emails reminders to members who have not submitted, then notes it on Telegram. To turn this path off, disable the trigger "Day 10 at 09:00 - Reminders" (right-click > Deactivate).

**Configure:**
- Credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2, Gmail OAuth2, Telegram bot, Google Gemini API key.
- Replace YOUR_PROFESSOR_EMAIL and YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in the Gmail/Telegram nodes.
- Pick spreadsheet "Lab Assistant" (YOUR_SHEET_ID) in every Sheets node. Tabs: Members (name|email|team|role), Monthly Submissions (timestamp|member_email|member_name|month|report_file|other_files).
- Set the workflow timezone to Africa/Cairo in Settings (schedule hours use it).
- Gemini node is optional: if it fails the email still goes out.
- Attach "Lab Assistant - Error Alert" in Settings > Error workflow; publish the workflow.

---
